findings.location: Foruten å være hennes beste venn, var en annen lysning for Hadassah at når Esther var på skolen, var ikke de andre jentene like slemme mot henne (Hadassah).
findings.source_quote: Besides being her best friend, another bright spot for Hadassah was that when Esther was in school the other girls weren’t as mean to her (Hadassah).
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the phrasing “en annen lysning” with a more natural Norwegian idiom such as “et annet lyspunkt”. Keep the rest of the sentence unchanged and preserve the paragraph tags.
